raw_segments.text: Thursday came. All work had been completed the previous evening. Carpets were laid down,
bed hangings festooned, radiant white counterpanes spread, toilet tables arranged, furniture
rubbed, flowers piled in vases. Both chambers and saloons looked as fresh and bright as
The hall, too, was scoured, and the great carved clock, as well as the steps and banisters
of the staircase, were polished to the brightness of glass. In the dining room, the sideboard
flashed resplendent with plate. In the drawing room and boudoir, vases of exotics bloomed
